summary: Examines the location privacy problem in Mobile IPv6, where the addresses in signaling or data packets can reveal where a mobile node is and how it moves. It proposes solutions to hide that information. It is Experimental.

eli5.summary: If your mail always shows the address of where you are, anyone can follow you around. This document looks at ways to keep a roaming device's whereabouts private.

questions: how to protect location privacy in mobile ipv6
does mobile ipv6 reveal a node's location
